items.en: Management indicated that ASP declined amid fierce competition.
items.why: 用 "indicated" 委婉引述管理层说法以留出余地；用介词 "amid"（在……背景下/伴随）替代 because，优雅地将「价格下跌」与「竞争激烈」进行客观关联，避免了主观因果的绝对化。
items.when: 汇报某项业绩指标下滑，且需要指出外部市场环境影响时。
items.slot: Management indicated that [...] declined amid [...].
swap: According to management, [...] dropped due to [...]. (更直接、口语化，因果关系更生硬)
Management stated that [...] decreased in the context of [...]. (更正式、中立，强调大背景而非动态过程)

items.en: Management represented that the agreement will be renewed on annual basis.
items.why: 使用审计与尽调专用词 "represented"（陈述/声称），既明确了信息源头在管理层，又暗示此信息尚未得到底层合同证实；"on annual basis" 比 "every year" 更具商业文本的规范感。
items.when: 引用管理层对未来合同续签、合作期限等口头承诺或未落实条款的陈述。
items.slot: Management represented that the [...] will be [...] on annual basis.
swap: Management claimed that the [...] is to be renewed yearly. (用 claimed 怀疑色彩更重，yearly 较为口语)
Management confirmed their intention to renew the [...] annually. (用 confirmed 语气更确定，强调主观意愿而非客观事实)

items.en: Management represented that these start-up costs were paid to some consulting companies.
items.why: 动词 "represented" 精准界定了这是管理层的「单方面陈述」而非审计师核实的结果；"some consulting companies" 模糊化处理，既复述了管理层的宽泛解释，又暗示缺乏具体收款方明细。
items.when: 解释某笔资金去向或费用性质，但尚未看到具体发票或合同凭证时。
items.slot: Management represented that these [...] were paid to [...].
swap: Management explained that these [...] went to [...]. (explained 语气较温和，went to 较为非正式)
Management asserted that these [...] had been disbursed to [...]. (asserted 语气更强硬，强调管理层单方面的坚称)

items.en: Management explained that the balance will be settled once the penalty issue is resolved.
items.why: 用 "explained" 引入客观解释；用 "once [...] is resolved" 构成一个清晰的条件状语，将「结清尾款」与「解决争议」两个动作的先后顺序和因果关系表达得极其干练，省去了复杂的条件句。
items.when: 说明某项待付款项、未结余额的支付前提或后续解决触发条件。
items.slot: Management explained that the [...] will be settled once the [...] is resolved.
swap: Management said they will pay the [...] after they solve the [...]. (口语化，用 active voice 显得主观，不如原文被动语态客观)
Management clarified that payment of the [...] is contingent upon the resolution of [...]. (更极其正式，contingent upon 商务感极强，但句式较重)

items.en: Management indicated that the cash and construction cost are centrally managed by Pangda.
items.why: "centrally managed by"（由……集中管理/统筹）是一个极佳的组织架构和资金流向描述词，比 simple words 如 "controlled by" 更具中性、客观的集团化运营色彩。
items.when: 描述子公司、关联方或特定项目资金与成本归属于集团总部统一调配时。
items.slot: Management indicated that the [...] and [...] are centrally managed by [...].
swap: Management said that [...] controls the [...] and [...]. (主动语态，强调控制权，语气较生硬)
Management stated that the [...] and [...] are under the centralized control of [...]. (更强调控制关系，偏向法务/合规视角)

items.en: Management indicated that the volume rebates are usually fully settled in the following year.
items.why: 连续使用 "usually"（通常）和 "fully"（完全）两个副词，既精确描述了返利结算的常态规律与完整度，又在时间（下一年度）上留有余地，避免了绝对化的表达。
items.when: 描述某种周期性费用、返利或款项结算的常规商业惯例时。
items.slot: Management indicated that the [...] are usually fully settled in [...].
swap: Management said that [...] are normally paid off next year. (normally 较口语，paid off 显得不够商务)
Management represented that [...] are typically cleared in full during [...]. (typically cleared in full 同样正式，cleared 侧重清算，settled 侧重结算)

items.en: We understand the interest incurred has been paid monthly.
items.why: 使用后置定语 "interest incurred" 简洁交代利息状态，配合主句 "We understand" 柔化语气，既确认了事实，又避免了绝对化的口吻。
items.when: 用于向客户陈述某项财务费用（如利息）的既往支付频率，且该信息来源于未审计账目或日常沟通时。
items.slot: We understand the [...] incurred has been paid [...].
swap: According to the records, the interest incurred has been paid monthly. (语气更客观，强调依据账面记录而非主观理解)
We note that the incurred interest was paid on a monthly basis. (语气更正式，用 we note 替代 we understand，显得发现更加确凿)

items.en: We understand that the Target has not incurred any interest in the past.
items.why: 用 "incurred any interest" 代替普通的 "had no interest"，措辞更符合财务英语规范；配合现在完成时 "has not incurred" 准确界定从过去持续到报告期的无利息状态。
items.when: 用于确认标的公司在历史期间没有产生过任何利息费用或负债。
items.slot: We understand that the Target has not incurred any [...] in the past.
swap: We are advised that no interest has been incurred by the Target historically. (语气更被动，强调信息是由对方告知，责任边界更清晰)
Based on our understanding, the Target did not incur interest in prior periods. (语气更具条理性，用 Based on 引导，时间维度用 prior periods 显得更正式)

items.en: We understand you are contemplating acquiring 100% of the shares of the Target.
items.why: 动词 "contemplate"（意图、考虑）极其传神，比 "plan to" 或 "want to" 更显专业和分寸感，精准描述了客户处于“意向阶段”而非“已敲定”的商业状态。
items.when: 在报告开头或背景介绍中，阐述客户当前的潜在交易意向和收购比例。
items.slot: We understand you are contemplating acquiring [...] of the shares of the Target.
swap: We understand that you are considering the acquisition of 100% of the Target's shares. (语气更正式，使用名词化结构 the acquisition of 增加了书面语感)
We understand your intention is to acquire a 100% equity interest in the Target. (语气更明确，直接指向客户的 intention，并用 equity interest 替代 shares 显得更严谨)

items.en: We understand that you are contemplating to acquire minority interest in the Target.
items.why: 同样使用 "contemplate" 表达意向，并用 "minority interest"（少数股权）这一标准财务术语，准确界定了非控股权的交易性质。
items.when: 用于描述客户计划收购标的公司非控股、少数股权的交易背景。
items.slot: We understand that you are contemplating to acquire [...] in the Target.
swap: We understand you are looking to acquire a minority stake in the Target. (语气略显口语化，用 looking to 替代 contemplating，用 stake 替代 interest)
We understand that your proposed transaction involves the acquisition of a minority interest in the Target. (语气极正式，用 proposed transaction involves 替代直接的动词，增加客观度)

items.en: We understand from management that the land use right has not been transferred as at the report date.
items.why: 插入语 "from management" 极好地锁定了信息源，而时间状语 "as at the report date"（截至报告日）则精准限制了事实的时效性，避免了对未来变化的无限期背书。
items.when: 用于披露某项资产权属尚未完成转移，且该信息直接来源于管理层访谈。
items.slot: We understand from management that the [...] has not been [...] as at the report date.
swap: Management has informed us that the land use right remains untransferred as of the date of this report. (语气更直接，将管理层设为主语，用 remains untransferred 强调未决状态)
According to management, the transfer of the land use right has not been completed as of the report date. (语气更中立，用 According to 引入，并将动词 transferred 替换为名词 transfer，结构更稳重)

items.en: Based on our review, CQ ICC was subject to LUT at Rmb20/m2 per year based on the land used.
items.why: 双重 based on 结构极其严密。前一个界定了“信息发现的局限范围”，后一个指明了“税费计算的法定依据”，中间用被动语态 was subject to 客观陈述纳税义务，无懈可击。
items.when: 用于在尽调报告中引用审阅发现，说明标的项目或资产在特定计税基础下应承担的法定税费。
items.slot: Based on our review, [...] was subject to [...] at [...] based on [...].
swap: According to our review, [...] was liable for [...] calculated on [...] (语气同样客观，但 liable for 强调法定义务，法律色彩更浓)
Our review indicates that [...] incurred [...] on the basis of [...] (语气较温和，侧重于财务账目呈现的客观结果)

items.en: Based on our review, in FY18 SH MH was subject to LUT at Rmb 6/m2 per year based on the land used.
items.why: 信息密度极高。在简短的句子中，将时间维度（in FY18）、主体、适用税率（at Rmb 6/m2）以及计算标准（based on the land used）紧密缝合，层次极清。
items.when: 用于按年度披露标的公司某项特定资产或项目的实际税费负担及计算标准。
items.slot: Based on our review, in [...] [...] was subject to [...] at [...] based on [...].
swap: Our review shows that in [...], [...] was charged [...] at [...] based on [...] (语气更直接，用 was charged 强调实际发生的被征收费用)
As indicated by our review, [...] was subject to [...] of [...] in [...] based on [...] (语气更为正式，突出审阅报告的客观指引作用)

items.en: Based on our review, CQ Manhattan Ph3 was subject to LUT at Rmb16/m2 per year based on the land used.
items.why: 通过首尾两个 based on，巧妙地将“顾问的专业工作边界（our review）”与“政府的计税依据（land used）”彻底隔离，既完成了事实披露，又做好了合规免责。
items.when: 用于向客户汇报特定项目分期的税费合规风险，明确区分事实依据与顾问的工作边界。
items.slot: Based on our review, [...] was subject to [...] at [...] based on [...].
swap: Pursuant to our review, [...] fell under the scope of [...] at [...] based on [...] (语气更具法律条理性，pursuant to 显得非常严谨正式)
We noted from our review that [...] was subject to [...] at [...] on the basis of [...] (语气更温和，以 We noted 引导，降低直接断言的强硬度)

items.en: Based on our discussion with Finance Manager, the Target did not make social insurance contributions for all the caregivers and back office staff.
items.why: 开篇使用 Based on our discussion with... 明确限定了事实信息的单一来源（口头访谈而非账套审计），在指出标的公司未足额缴纳社保这一敏感合规问题时，起到了极佳的免责保护作用。
items.when: 用于披露通过口头访谈获知的标的公司不合规事项，需要明确信息源以防未来产生事实争议。
items.slot: Based on our discussion with [...], the Target did not make [...] for all the [...].
swap: According to the Finance Manager, the Target failed to pay [...] for [...] (语气更直接，failed to pay 比 did not make contributions 违规定性更强)
As represented by the Finance Manager, the Target did not contribute to [...] for [...] (语气最安全，As represented by 将陈述责任完全归于对方的陈述)

items.en: We noted that the principal of six loans (“defaulted loans”) were overdue.
items.why: 句中使用括号加引号“ (“defaulted loans”) ”在首次提及事项时直接完成术语定义，顺畅连接事实陈述与后续简称，避免了另起一句解释的冗余。
items.when: 用于在汇报违约或异常事项时，直接为特定样本或分类赋予简洁的定义名称。
items.slot: We noted that the principal of [...] (“[...]”) were overdue.
swap: Our review revealed that six loans with an aggregate principal of [...] had missed their due dates.（用名词短语 aggregate principal 强调累计本金金额，语气更为严谨）
It was observed that the principal of six loans fell past due.（使用被动语态 It was observed，措辞更具中立客观色彩）

items.en: We noted that Management has not fully reflected un-paid tax payables in the accounts.
items.why: 使用“has not fully reflected”代替“omitted”或“failed to record”，客观指出账务记录的不完整性，措辞克制且保留了专业余地。
items.when: 用于指出管理层存在账务少计、漏记或披露不充分，但需保持专业中立态度时。
items.slot: We noted that Management has not fully reflected [...] in the accounts.
swap: Management appears to have understated [...] in the current financial records.（用 appears to have 增加推测缓冲，语气比直接否定更缓和）
Certain [...] were found to be omitted from the general ledger.（使用被动语态陈述事实，语气偏向技术性客观说明）

items.en: We note that in our experience, it would be very difficult to adopt the deemed profit method in Shanghai.
items.why: 插入介词短语“in our experience”作为限定前提，搭配虚拟语气“it would be”，明确表达这是基于过往实操的专业推断，既有专业权威度又留有余地。
items.when: 用于基于顾问团队过往实操经验，对某种方案在特定地区的落地可行性进行预警时。
items.slot: We note that in our experience, it would be very difficult to adopt [...] in [...].
swap: Based on past precedents, adopting [...] in [...] presents significant operational challenges.（用 presents significant operational challenges 替换形容词，提升书面正式度）
Our past engagements suggest that implementing [...] in [...] is highly unlikely to be approved.（使用 suggest 表达提示性意见，侧重可行性概率）

items.en: We identified and reclassified expenses that obviously belong to the headquarters according to the journal entries.
items.why: 动词组合“identified and reclassified”精准复现“识别并重分类”的工作流程，结尾句尾紧跟证据来源“according to...”，逻辑环环相扣。
items.when: 用于说明根据账目凭证等事实依据，对归属不当的费用进行重新归集与调整时。
items.slot: We identified and reclassified [...] that obviously belong to [...] according to [...].
swap: Based on primary accounting vouchers, relevant [...] were reallocated to [...].（采用被动语态配合 reallocated，突出凭证依据与再分配动作）
Adjustments were made to transfer [...] back to [...] upon review of the ledger entries.（以 Adjustments were made 开头，优先强调调整动作与结果）

items.en: Quality of earnings (1/3) | We identified a few accounting adjustments and normalization adjustments during our due diligence.
items.why: 平行并列“accounting adjustments”（会计调整）与“normalization adjustments”（经常性/非经常性规范调整），用词标准规范，信息密度极高。
items.when: 用于在尽调报告的 QoE 章节总结针对财务报表所做的不同性质的调整事项时。
items.slot: [...] | We identified a few [...] adjustments and [...] adjustments during our due diligence.
swap: During the financial review, we proposed several GAAP and normalization adjustments to earnings.（用 proposed 表达建议性调整，强调对利润的影响）
Our analysis uncovered multiple accounting and EBITDA adjustments.（用 uncovered 代替 identified，语气更强调通过深入尽调挖出潜在问题）

items.en: We note that Gaopan and Kunming have recognised DTAs and we summarize the net deferred tax balances as of 31 December 2018, 2019 and 2020 in the opposite table.
items.why: 使用“as of [连续年份]”精准限定多个时间节点，并用“in the opposite table”实现高效的版面交叉引用，图文配合极其顺畅。
items.when: 用于正文分析中引导读者查看对侧排版或附表中跨期数据的汇总统计时。
items.slot: We note that [...] have recognised [...] and we summarize [...] as of [...] in the opposite table.
swap: The historical balances of [...] as at [...] are presented in the adjacent chart.（使用 presented in the adjacent chart，语气侧重于版面的静态展示）
For a detailed breakdown of [...] as of [...], please refer to the corresponding table alongside.（用 please refer to 引出对侧表格，指引指令更明确）

items.en: Trends may be affected by foreign exchange exposure.
items.why: 用 may be affected by 将趋势变化归因于汇率风险的“潜在影响”，避免把趋势直接硬性归咎于单一因素，措辞客观严谨。
items.when: 分析数据趋势并提示汇率波动等外部不确定因素对数据产生扰动时使用。
items.slot: [...] may be affected by [...] exposure.
swap: Trends are affected by foreign exchange exposure.（使用了确凿的 are，语气过于绝对，缺少风险推测的缓冲）
Trends could potentially be driven by foreign exchange exposure.（用 could potentially 双重软化，语气比 may 更轻柔且偏假设）

items.en: It will help you identify whether something may be significant.
items.why: 在从句中嵌套 may be significant 进行二次软化，即便排查出异常也不直接定性为“重大”，给后续复核留足余地。
items.when: 指引读者使用某种分析方法去排查潜在重大风险或重要异常时使用。
items.slot: It will help you identify whether [...] may be significant.
swap: It will help you identify what is significant.（直接用 is 确定性过强，没有保留观察与推测余地）
It serves to flag items that might be significant.（用 might 代替 may，假设意味更浓，语气更委婉）

items.en: Also, some of the other operating expenses may be under-estimated.
items.why: 用 some of 限定范围并结合 may be under-estimated，对费用计提不足提出合理怀疑，避免直接指责数据失真。
items.when: 提示财务报表科目（如其他营运费用）可能存在少计或低估风险时使用。
items.slot: Also, some of [...] may be under-estimated.
swap: Also, other operating expenses are under-estimated.（断言式肯定句，语气过于生硬直接）
Additionally, there appears to be a potential underestimation of other operating expenses.（用 appears to be 与 potential 堆叠，距离感更强、更客套）

items.en: It may be useful to use metrics to understand the trends of certain balances.
items.why: 利用形式主语 It may be useful to 搭配 certain，以建设性建议语气提出分析方法，毫无强加于人的生硬感。
items.when: 建议读者采用特定指标或分析手段去查看某些科目余额的趋势时使用。
items.slot: It may be useful to [...] to understand the trends of [...].
swap: You must use metrics to analyze the trends of these balances.（使用 must 指令性太强，属于硬性要求而非建议）
It might be worth considering metrics to grasp the trends of specific balances.（用 might be worth considering，比原句更谦逊客气）

items.en: The following are some typical items which may be considered debt or debt-like.
items.why: 使用 may be considered 搭配并列词 debt or debt-like，将定性描述转化为“可被视作”的提议，为后续调整保留讨论弹性。
items.when: 列举类债务（Debt-like items）或净债务调整项清单时使用。
items.slot: The following are some typical items which may be considered [...].
swap: The following items are debt or debt-like.（直接下定义定性，缺乏专业报告应有的审慎与软化）
Below is a list of potential items that could be treated as debt-like.（用 could be treated as，语气偏向于协商讨论）

items.en: Tax prepayments may be on the account of the seller and not accessible to the buyer.
items.why: 通过 may be 对权益归属与可获取性表达可能性推测，客观提示交割后买方可能无法享受该资产的风险。
items.when: 分析预缴税款或待抵扣资产在交易交割后的实际可利用性时使用。
items.slot: [...] may be on the account of [...] and not accessible to [...].
swap: Tax prepayments belong to the seller and are not accessible to the buyer.（直接断言所有权与权限，缺少审慎推测缓冲）
Tax prepayments could potentially remain with the seller, rendering them unavailable to the buyer.（用 could potentially 搭配分词，语气更偏抽象推论）

items.en: Normalised numbers will provide a more meaningful picture.
items.why: 使用比较级 more meaningful 和比喻词 picture，巧妙避免了绝对化词汇，严谨地表达调整后的分析价值。
items.when: 用于阐述对原始财务报表进行正常化调整的必要性与分析价值。
items.slot: Normalised [...] will provide a more meaningful picture.
swap: Adjusted figures give a clearer view of underlying performance. （更强调“清晰度”与“底层业绩”，措辞更直白）
Normalised data facilitates a more representative comparison. （侧重表达数据的“可比性”与“代表性”，学术感更重）

items.en: We have proposed adjustment to record it in corresponding period.
items.why: 动词 proposed 表明专业建议立场，措辞有礼有节，对应的 corresponding period 则准确表达了跨期调整的时间归属。
items.when: 用于指出跨期错记事项并提出划归至正确会计期间的调整建议。
items.slot: We have proposed adjustment to record [...] in [...].
swap: We suggest an adjustment to reclassify this into the correct period. （语气更直接且偏口语化，用 correct 替换 corresponding）
An adjustment is recommended to align this entry with the appropriate period. （被动语态结合 enter 与 align，语气更具独立客观的专业感）

items.en: The comments in this draft report are subject to amendment or withdrawal.
items.why: 使用 subject to 明确了报告意见的非终局性，用 amendment or withdrawal 精准说明后续调整的两重可能性（修改或撤回），在规避法律风险的同时表达极为严谨。
items.when: 在提交草案报告、需要为后续可能调整或撤回意见留有余地时使用。
items.slot: The comments in this [...] report are subject to amendment or withdrawal.
swap: The findings presented in this draft are tentative and subject to revision.（语气更偏学术或正式分析，强调结论的暂定性）
Please note that the views in this draft may change as work progresses.（语气更软化且务实，适合日常项目沟通）

items.en: We recommend you should input the new arrangement in your valuation model.
items.why: 用 recommend 配合 input 精确指引客户将新约定纳入估值模型，动作指向极为明确，能够直接对接财务建模的操作步骤。
items.when: 在建议客户根据最新交易条款或尽调发现更新其财务与估值模型时使用。
items.slot: We recommend you should input [...] in your valuation model.
swap: We suggest reflecting the updated terms in your valuation framework.（语气稍微更加客观规范，避免了 recommend ... should 的双重建议感）
You may wish to incorporate the new arrangement into your model.（语气更具协商性，给客户更多自主决定空间）

items.en: The comments in this status update report are subject to amendment or withdrawal.
items.why: 将 status update report 与 subject to amendment or withdrawal 结合，既准确界定了当前交付物的阶段性质（阶段更新），又清晰划定了免责边界。
items.when: 在向客户提交中间进度汇报（Status Update）并防止客户将其误认为是最终报告时使用。
items.slot: The comments in this status update report are subject to [...].
swap: Observations in this progress update remain subject to change.（语气更简洁明了，适合简短简报）
This update is for discussion purposes only and remains non-binding.（语气侧重于强调法律上的非约束力）

items.en: We suggest you to have a more detailed discussion with the management on these areas.
items.why: 通过 have a more detailed discussion 将关注焦点聚焦于特定领域（these areas），精准引导下一步动作，既给出了专业方向又合理划定了顾问的职责界限。
items.when: 在发现疑点但超出当前尽调范围、需要客户与管理层进行深入访谈或谈判时使用。
items.slot: We suggest you to have a more detailed discussion with the management on [...].
swap: Further clarification from management on these matters is highly recommended.（采用被动语态，语气更偏客观中立）
We advise deep-diving into these specific issues with key management.（语气更有针对性，强调深挖特定问题）

items.en: Under the PRC law, billings, including expenses (and taxes), are subject to turnover taxes and surcharges.
items.why: 通过 Under the PRC law 明确法律依据，用 include... 详尽列举计税基数范围，并用 subject to turnover taxes and surcharges 精准表述法定税费承担关系。
items.when: 在涉及中国境内开票、费用结算及税费负担提示的专业意见段落中使用。
items.slot: Under the [...] law, billings, including [...], are subject to [...].
swap: According to local tax regulations, gross billings will incur applicable indirect taxes.（语气更通用，适用于非特定法域的合规提示）
Pursuant to PRC tax rules, relevant expenses and fees are liable for turnover surcharges.（语气更具法律文书的规范感和严谨度）

items.en: The breakdown is only preliminary and may subject to further changes upon receipt of following information.
items.why: 结合 preliminary（初步的）与 upon receipt of（收到……后），清楚交代了数据的阶段限定与后续调整的前置条件，因果逻辑清晰。
items.when: 在提供初步数据拆分、且该数据高度依赖后续补充材料时使用。
items.slot: The breakdown is only preliminary and may [...] upon receipt of [...].
swap: This categorization is tentative and remains conditional upon pending documentation.（语气更为正式严密，强调受限于未收到的文档）
The provided split is provisional and will be updated once more data is available.（语气相对直接明了，适合快节奏沟通）

items.t: 政府补助可持续性尽调分析
items.en: Non-recurring government subsidies constituted RMB 45.2 million, or 28.5%, of reported EBIT in FY25, following a similar influx of RMB 38.0 million in FY24. The heavy concentration of these grants within local municipal funds suggests a heightened vulnerability to regional fiscal tightening, casting reasonable doubt on their full recurrence in 9M26 and FY26F. Management’s inclusion of these non-operational inflows in baseline EBITDA projections appears overly optimistic given the discretionary nature of such awards. Consequently, a downward adjustment to run-rate earnings is advisable to isolate core operating performance from temporary policy-driven tailwinds.

notes.q: The heavy concentration of these grants within local municipal funds
notes.why: 用动作抽象出的名词短语作主语，替代原因状语从句，显著提升了句子的信息密度与专业感。

notes.q: Management’s inclusion of these non-operational inflows
notes.why: 将“管理层把非经营性流入纳入计算”压缩为名词短语，使逻辑主语更紧凑并顺畅连接谓语。

notes.q: appears overly optimistic given the discretionary nature of such awards
notes.why: 用 appears 开展语气软化，配合介词短语引导的名词化词组，使尽调结论客观且保留余地。

take: The heavy concentration of […] within […] suggests a heightened vulnerability to […].
Management’s inclusion of […] in […] appears overly optimistic given […].
Consequently, a downward adjustment to […] is advisable to isolate […] from […].

items.en: Management represented the Target and the fellow companies do not share the Marketing Agencies.
items.why: 使用 Management represented 明确归因于管理层陈述，同时用 fellow companies 精确指代同系关联公司，语言干净无赘词。
items.when: 用于说明标的公司与关联公司在供应商或业务资源上保持独立、无交叉混用时。
items.slot: Management represented the Target and the [...] do not share [...].
swap: Management stated that the Target and its affiliates operate independent marketing agencies. (语气更书面化，强调独立运营事实)
According to management, there is no overlap in marketing agencies between the Target and sibling entities. (语气偏客观陈述，突出无资源重叠)

items.en: Target management represented they are in the processing of amending the amount to US$225 million.
items.why: 用 in the process[ing] of 短语精准表征“事项正在推进中”，为尚未最终落定的金额修改留出了恰当的语言弹性。
items.when: 用于汇报合同条款、交易对价或协议金额正在进行变更的过渡阶段。
items.slot: Target management represented they are in the process of amending [...] to [...].
swap: Management confirmed that the amendment of the amount to US$225 million is currently underway. (语气更严谨，强调流程已在推进中)
Management reported that they are actively revising the figure toward US$225 million. (语气更具动态感，突出管理层的积极动作)

items.en: Management explained that BPDB will not pay cash to the Target until the penalty issue was resolved.
items.why: 采用 will not ... until ... 句型建立起清晰的因果与前置条件逻辑链，明确表达了款项冻结的触发条件。
items.when: 用于解释第三方延期付款或暂停结算的特定前置条件时。
items.slot: Management explained that [...] will not pay [...] until [...] was resolved.
swap: Management clarified that cash payment from BPDB remains conditional upon resolving the penalty issue. (语气更商务规范，用 conditional 代替条件句型)
Management indicated that cash payout by BPDB is withheld pending the resolution of the penalty issue. (语气带有报告体色彩，用 withheld/pending 显出专业严谨)

items.en: Management explained that Jinchen will provide more services that do not involve the use of medicine.
items.why: 通过定语从句 that do not involve ... 精确界定了业务拓展的合规边界，语言排他性极强，有效防止信息误读。
items.when: 用于澄清未来业务扩展不会触及敏感领域或特定监管资质时。
items.slot: Management explained that [...] will provide more services that do not involve [...].
swap: Management noted that upcoming services from Jinchen will explicitly exclude medical applications. (语气更硬朗直接，用 exclude 强调排他)
Management indicated that Jinchen intends to expand into non-medicinal service lines. (语气更概括，用形容词短语进行分类)

items.en: Management explained that it identified the 35% through tracking the recipient names of the tax invoice.
items.why: 动词短语 identified ... through tracking ... 精确呈现了得出特定数据的核查路径，归因清晰，动作指向性极强。
items.when: 用于说明管理层获取某个统计数据或比例背后的具体分析手段与依据。
items.slot: Management explained that it identified [...] through tracking [...].
swap: Management clarified that the 35% figure was determined by tracing the invoice recipient details. (语气使用被动语态，侧重数据本身的推导结果)
Management noted that cross-referencing invoice recipients led to the 35% estimate. (语气强调分析动作与结论之间的因果联系)

items.en: Management indicated that there will be further grants from the current RSU pool to make up the deficit.
items.why: 用 there will be further grants ... to make up ... 表达管理层未来的补救打算，既交代了预期方案，又与最终执行保持了恰当的陈述距离。
items.when: 用于说明管理层计划如何利用现有激励池或资源储备弥补相应缺口。
items.slot: Management indicated that there will be further grants from [...] to make up [...].
swap: Management stated that additional grants will be issued from the existing RSU pool to cover the shortfall. (语气更正式，用 cover the shortfall 替代 make up the deficit)
According to management, the deficit is expected to be offset by future RSU allocations. (语气客观中立，强调对冲机制与预期状态)

items.en: We understand that the Target did not actually engage in many R&D activities during the review period.
items.why: 开头用 We understand 做软化，后接 did not actually 和 engage in many 巧妙降低否定语气的对抗性，既说明了研发活动匮乏的事实，又留有措辞余地。
items.when: 阐述标的公司实际经营与账面声称不符、但需谨慎表达结论时。
items.slot: We understand that [...] did not actually engage in [...] during [...].
swap: According to our review, the Target had limited R&D activities during the period.（语气更客观直接，用 limited 替换否定句）
It appears that the Target's R&D activities were minimal during the review period.（语气更谨慎，用 It appears 提供双重模糊化）

items.en: We understand from management that the intention of the arrangement is to transfer the profit to the List Co.
items.why: 明确插入 from management 将信息来源准确归因于管理层口述，搭配 intention of the arrangement 准确揭示交易安排背后的实质目的。
items.when: 说明某项复杂交易安排或会计处理的商业实质意图、且该信息源自管理层访谈时。
items.slot: We understand from management that the intention of [...] is to [...].
swap: Management indicated that the primary objective of this setup is to transfer profit to List Co.（语气更直接，明确强调管理层的表态）
Based on discussions with management, this arrangement aims to divert profit to List Co.（语气偏客观推导，强调基于访谈记录分析）

items.en: We understand Agile Listco was suffering some cash flow issues which will further increase the turnover days.
items.why: 巧妙使用 was suffering ... which will ... 的定语从句，将关联方的历史/现状困境与未来财务指标（周转天数）的恶化建立起明确的因果推导关联。
items.when: 分析客户或关联方的财务健康状况，并评估其对标的公司营运资金指标的连带影响时。
items.slot: We understand [...] was suffering [...] which will further increase [...].
swap: We understand that cash flow pressure at Agile Listco is likely to drive up turnover days.（语气更精练，用 drive up 替换较冗长的从句）
Agile Listco's cash flow constraints are expected to further lengthen turnover days.（语气更书面客观，去除了主观开场词）

items.en: We understand the Target mainly engages in production and transmission of electricity in Pangaon, Keraniganj, Bangladesh.
items.why: 动词短语 engages in 使用地道规范，简洁明了地涵盖了主营业务类型与具体经营地理位置，属于标准的高质量尽调语言。
items.when: 在报告概览或公司背景介绍中，快速定性标的公司的核心业务范围与经营地点时。
items.slot: We understand the Target mainly engages in [...] in [...].
swap: The Target's principal business comprises the production and transmission of electricity in Pangaon, Keraniganj, Bangladesh.（语气更正式严肃，适合放在公司介绍页标题）
The Target operates primarily in electricity production and transmission in Pangaon, Keraniganj, Bangladesh.（语气更动态，强调实际经营动作）

items.en: We understand the increase of the construction in progress was mainly due to effect of the acquisition of Sanjiu Hospital.
items.why: 归因清晰，用 was mainly due to将报表科目（在建工程）的异常变动直接锚定到具体的单一重大历史事件（并购）。
items.when: 解释资产负债表科目或损益表项目发生重大单笔变动的具体驱动因素时。
items.slot: We understand the increase of [...] was mainly due to effect of [...].
swap: The rise in construction in progress primary resulted from the acquisition of Sanjiu Hospital.（语气更地道精炼，用 resulted from 替换 due to effect of）
We note that the increase in construction in progress was driven largely by the Sanjiu Hospital acquisition.（语气更偏向分析视角，强调驱动因素）

items.en: From our search and management discussion, we noted that five individual Marketing Agencies directly or indirectly hold equity interests in five Medical Logistics Partners.
items.why: 句首用“From our...”精准归因信息来源，配合“we noted that”做客观中立的陈述；“directly or indirectly hold equity interests in”严密涵盖各种显性与隐性持股结构，表述极为规范且严谨。
items.when: 用于尽调报告中汇报背景调查、关联方核查或股权穿透发现时。
items.slot: From our […] and […], we noted that […] directly or indirectly hold equity interests in […].
swap: Based on our public records search and management inquiries, it was identified that [Entity A] holds direct or indirect shares in [Entity B].（相比原句使用被动语态，风格更加非人化、中立客观）
Our research and discussions with management revealed that [Entity A] maintains equity stakes in [Entity B], either directly or through intermediaries.（相比原句使用动词 revealed，语气略显主动且措辞变体更丰富）
According to our findings and management representations, [Entity A] is linked to [Entity B] via direct or indirect equity ownership.（相比原句用 is linked to，表达更侧重于强调两者之间的关联性）

items.en: We have not been provided with a reasonable explanation on the basis of the financial costs.
items.why: 用被动语态 have not been provided with 将责任中立地归于客观信息缺失，避免直接指责管理层；用 on the basis of 精准锁定对成本计算依据的追问。
items.when: 当目标公司未能对某项异常费用或成本构成提供合理的计算依据时使用。
items.slot: We have not been provided with a reasonable explanation on [...].
swap: Management failed to explain the basis of [...] - 语气更硬，直接将未提供解释的责任归咎于管理层。
No detailed breakdown or underlying basis was made available for [...] - 语气更中立客观，完全隐去主语，仅陈述材料缺失事实。

items.en: Given that all these litigations are ongoing, we were unable to estimate the possible financial impact.
items.why: 用 Given that 置前交代不可抗客观前提，搭配缓和词 unable to estimate 与 possible financial impact，在阐明做不到的同时严密防范专业免责风险。
items.when: 因诉讼、仲裁等未来事件尚未定案，导致无法在报告期内量化潜在财务损失时使用。
items.slot: Given that [...], we were unable to estimate the possible financial impact.
swap: As [...] remains pending, quantifying the financial impact is not feasible at this stage - 语气更书面化，用非人称主语使结论显得更客观沉稳。
We cannot assess the financial exposure due to [...] - 语气更直接明确，直奔无法评估风险的主题。

items.en: We were not able to quantify the impact as management did not keep any information on the timing of vehicle delivery.
items.why: 先给结论 were not able to quantify，再用 as 紧跟事实原因；did not keep any information 明确界定是由于管理层原始记录缺失导致分析受限。
items.when: 因管理层未记录或保存特定业务细节数据，导致顾问无法定量分析财务影响时使用。
items.slot: We were not able to quantify the impact as management did not keep any information on [...].
swap: Due to the absence of management records regarding [...], this impact remains unquantified - 语气更偏向正式公文风，用名词化结构代替主动否定句。
The impact cannot be measured owing to a lack of data on [...] - 语气更客观紧凑，强调数据缺乏这一客观条件。

items.en: Note: We did not receive the FY18 and 9M19 financials of Hekang group, therefore we cannot comment on its performance.
items.why: 前半句用 did not receive 清楚陈述未拿到数据的客观事实，后半句用连接词 therefore 顺理成章引出 cannot comment 的范围界限，因果逻辑极度清晰。
items.when: 因未获取到标的公司或其关联方的历史财务报表，需要做出明确的分析范围免责声明时使用。
items.slot: Note: We did not receive [...], therefore we cannot comment on its performance.
swap: As [...] financials were not made available, we refrain from expressing an opinion on its performance - 语气更具专业合规感，用 refrain from 表达审慎立场。
In the absence of [...] financial data, no assessment could be performed regarding its performance - 语气更严密中立，彻底排除第一人称主语。

items.en: Start-up cost: Based on the description of journal entries, we did not found the start-up cost of Pudong nursing centre.
items.why: 明确限定核查路径 Based on the description of journal entries，避免结论被过度解读为“该费用绝对不存在”，仅精准表明在当前会计凭证描述中未查见。
items.when: 依据特定会计凭证或账务记录进行抽查，但未查找到特定科目或项目支出时使用。
items.slot: [...]: Based on [...], we did not found the [...] of [...].
swap: Based on [...], we identified no explicit record of [...] - 语气更正规优雅，修正了原句语法瑕疵并使用肯定的句式表达否定意义。
From our review of [...], no [...] was identified - 语气更客观被动，突出复核动作与客观查验结果。

items.en: Accordingly, we did not exclude the government grants from QoE in our adjustment B but highlighted here for your attention.
items.why: 用 Accordingly 衔接前文逻辑，用 did not exclude... but highlighted 形成转折，既明确了未做财务调整的处理决定，又通过 highlighted here for your attention 履行的风险提示职责。
items.when: 对某项争议科目未做账务调整，但仍需提醒客户或决策方在交易谈判中予以关注时使用。
items.slot: Accordingly, we did not exclude [...] from [...] in [...] but highlighted here for your attention.
swap: We have retained [...] in [...] without adjustment, but bring this item to your special attention - 语气更主动，强调顾问的主动提示动作。
While no adjustment was made to remove [...] from [...], this matter is noted for client consideration - 语气更偏第三方报告体，正式且客观。

items.en: There may be good reason for the latter 8 months being higher than the first four months.
items.why: 使用 `there may be good reason for...` 替代直接断定偏高是否合理，既指出了数据前后对比的异常，又为管理层的后续解释保留了弹性空间。
items.when: 用于说明财务数据出现前后不一致、但可能存在合理商业解释的场景。
items.slot: There may be good reason for [...] being [...] than [...].
swap: It is likely that [...] is higher due to [...] (语气稍确凿，偏向已形成初步合理推断)
Management should explain why [...] exceeds [...] (语气转为主动要求解释，专业怀疑度更高)

items.en: The fees for these other engagements may be success based or contingent on a certain outcome.
items.why: 将软化词 `may be` 与专业词汇 `success based` 和 `contingent on` 结合，精准列举非固定收费的常见模式，表述专业且不把情况说死。
items.when: 用于说明第三方服务费或咨询费等支出存在或有支付条件时的场景。
items.slot: The fees for [...] may be success based or contingent on [...].
swap: The fees for [...] depend heavily on [...] (语气更客观直接，明确指出费用对特定条件的依赖)
Part of the fees for [...] could be tied to [...] (语气稍软，侧重说明部分费用存在潜在关联)

items.en: In the case of a transaction involving part of a group, there may be a combination of the two.
items.why: 句首用 `In the case of...` 精确限定适用前提，句中用 `may be a combination of the two` 涵盖两种模式并存的可能性，避免绝对化归类。
items.when: 用于分析拆分重组或复杂交易架构中，多种机制可能同时适用的情形。
items.slot: In the case of [...], there may be a combination of [...].
swap: For [...], a hybrid approach of [...] is typically adopted (语气更偏向行业惯例总结，定性更明确)
[...] might involve elements of both [...] (语气更轻微，强调可能包含双重元素)

items.en: The nature and amount of audited cash flow of 6M22 may be different to the illustrative cash flow.
items.why: 用 `nature and amount` 从“性质”与“金额”双维度铺开评价对象，配合 `may be different to` 提示差异，严谨且不偏颇。
items.when: 用于提示测算数据/假设数据与最终审计落实数据之间可能存在出入。
items.slot: The nature and amount of [...] may be different to [...].
swap: The actual [...] could deviate from [...] (语气更具警示性，使用 deviate 强调偏离风险)
[...] does not necessarily match [...] (语气偏中性客观，仅说明两者不一定完全一致)

items.en: The projected operating cashflow inflow appears to be optimistic based on recent financial performance.
items.why: 用 `appears to be` 替代 `is` 软化评估判断，同时用 `based on recent financial performance` 给出客观依据，既表达质疑又显得中立专业。
items.when: 用于对管理层提供的预测数据（如未来现金流）表达合理怀疑、认为其偏乐观时。
items.slot: The projected [...] appears to be optimistic based on [...].

items.when: 用于解释某一法律或财务协议条款在交易文件中的呈现形式（独立签署或嵌入主合同）。
items.slot: [...] sets out [...] and may be a separate document.
swap: [...] details [...] and can exist as a standalone agreement (语气更肯定，强调其作为独立协议存在的能力)

items.en: We have normalised the trading results in the Qualify of Earnings.
items.why: 使用规范动词 normalise 搭配具体对象 trading results，准确表达将非经常性损益还原为常态化经营业绩的过程，语气严谨专业。
items.when: 在写 Quality of Earnings (QoE) 章节阐述对历史业绩进行剔除与还原等正常化调整时使用。
items.slot: We have normalised the [...] in the Qualify of Earnings.

items.en: The sales price was adjusted to reflect the value of the business.
items.why: 用不定式短语 to reflect... 简洁有力地交代调整售价的终极目的，避免了用 because of 或 for the purpose of 等冗长句式。
items.when: 用于说明交易对价或销售价格进行调整背后的归因逻辑。
items.slot: The sales price was adjusted to reflect [...].

items.when: 需要对特定的税后毛利或具体业务板块的损益指标进行量化还原时使用。
items.slot: We have normalised the [...] (after [...]) of the businesses here.

items.en: We have made the adjustment to reflect his cost in the Target’s financials.

items.slot: We have raised an adjustment to remove the P&L impact of [...].

items.slot: […] was the […] for […], which was subject to […].

items.en: For the related party balances, We recommend that these balances should be cleaned up, to the extent possible, prior to closing.

items.t: 折旧政策变更的正常化调整
items.en: In FY25, the Group extended the useful life of its core manufacturing equipment from 5 to 8 years, which reduced annual depreciation charges by approximately RMB 45 million. On an adjusted basis, excluding the RMB 33.8 million year-to-date impact in 9M26, normalized EBITDA margin for the period would have been 14.2% rather than the reported 16.5%. This accounting tweak artificially boosted reported operating profit, masking a slight underlying contraction in gross margins driven by higher raw material costs. Management attributes the extension to improved maintenance protocols; however, the lower depreciation rate appears aggressive when compared with the 5-year industry standard. Consequently, full-year FY26F net earnings may be overstated by an estimated RMB 40-45 million unless normalized adjustments are factored into the valuation model.

notes.q: On an adjusted basis, excluding the RMB 33.8 million year-to-date impact in 9M26, normalized EBITDA margin for the period would have been 14.2% rather than the reported 16.5%.
notes.why: 使用虚拟语气与对比句式精准量化政策剔除后的影响，是做正常化调整（Normalization）时的标准书面表达。

notes.q: artificially boosted reported operating profit, masking a slight underlying contraction
notes.why: 动词组合“人为抬高……掩盖了本质上的下滑”能非常客观且犀利地揭示会计政策变动对真实业绩的失真影响。

items.t: 汇率波动对毛利影响的归因与正常化分析
items.en: For FY25, the Target’s gross margin contracted by 120 basis points, largely attributable to the sharp appreciation of the CNY against the USD during the settlement window. On a constant currency basis, however, the underlying margin would have remained resilient at approximately 28.5%, effectively offsetting the 4.2% increase in raw material costs. This FX-induced headwind resulted in a non-cash translational loss of $2.4 million, which we have normalized in our adjusted EBITDA bridge to reflect the core operational performance. Looking ahead to 9M26, the management has implemented a rolling hedge strategy to mitigate further downside risk, although FY26F projections remain sensitive to any breach of the 7.20 threshold. While these measures provide a buffer, the inherent volatility in cross-border settlements necessitates a cautious interpretation of the forecasted net recovery.

notes.why: 标准的归因表达，将财务指标的变化（contracted）直接关联到特定的宏观因素。
财务尽调中进行“正常化”处理的固定术语，用于剔除汇率波动以比较经营性业绩。

notes.q: normalized in our adjusted EBITDA bridge
notes.why: 量化分析的动作描述，说明该数字已被放入调整表（Bridge）中以修正报表利润。
用于预测（FY26F）的软化表达，量化了风险点但保留了专业审慎余地。

[预测指标] remain sensitive to [外部变量], necessitating a cautious interpretation of [预期结果].

items.en: Management does not provide the classification basis of different department, we classify them based on our understanding.

swap: In the absence of […] from management, we have categorized them based on our professional judgment. (更正式，强调专业判断)
As management did not specify […], the classification is based on our interpretation of the data. (语气中性，侧重对数据的解读)

items.when: 在尽调报告的执行摘要或财务分析章节中，概括性地陈述发现的调整事项。

items.t: 政府补助可持续性及其对盈利影响的评估
items.en: The Target’s reliance on non-recurring government grants reached a peak in FY24, contributing 15% to its total pre-tax profit. However, the subsequent contraction of local fiscal budgets led to a noticeable decline in subsidy disbursements during 9M26. This downward trend raises concerns regarding the replicability of such windfall gains in FY26F and beyond. Management’s anticipation of future policy support remains subject to significant uncertainty given the shift in regional industrial priorities. Consequently, the exclusion of these one-off items from core earnings is necessary for a normalized assessment of the Target’s operational profitability.

items.t: 折旧政策变更的财务量化与分析
items.en: In FY25, the Target extended the estimated useful lives of its production machinery from five to eight years, resulting in a non-recurring depreciation saving of USD 2.4 million. To ensure comparability across periods, we have applied a normalization adjustment to FY25 EBITDA to reflect the historical run-rate prior to this accounting estimate change. For 9M26, the cumulative impact of this policy shift contributed approximately 120 basis points to the reported gross margin. Looking ahead to FY26F, the full-year recurring benefit is expected to stabilize as newer CAPEX additions are recognized under the revised schedule. While this change aligns with general industry benchmarks, it appears to partially mask a underlying contraction in operational efficiency during the period under review.

items.t: 并购估值中的断言、观察与推迟判断
items.en: The Target’s adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 18.5% in FY25, a performance largely attributable to favorable raw material pricing cycles. Management contends that upcoming efficiency gains will bridge this gap; however, we observe that these projections rely heavily on aggressive synergy assumptions. At this stage, we remain unable to assess the full impact of potential supply chain disruptions on the FY26F outlook pending further sensitivity analysis. This lack of visibility warrants a cautious approach to the final valuation, particularly regarding the earn-out structure.

items.t: 汇率波动对跨国结算影响的量化分析
items.en: In FY25, the Target's reported revenue grew by 12.4% year-on-year, though this figure was significantly bolstered by the strengthening of the USD against the CNY. On a constant currency basis, the organic growth rate narrows to approximately 8.2%, reflecting a 420-basis-point impact from favorable FX tailwinds. Management attributes this discrepancy to the lag in cross-border settlement cycles, where receivables booked in 9M26 may face margin compression if the current volatility persists. While the normalized EBITDA margin remains resilient at 18.5%, potential downside risks should be considered should the CNY rebound beyond the 7.10 threshold in FY26F. Consequently, we have adjusted the projected cash flows to account for these non-operational fluctuations, ensuring a more conservative valuation baseline.

items.t: 利率环境对融资成本影响的尽调分析
items.en: The Target’s weighted average cost of debt surged to 6.2% in FY25, up from 4.8% in FY24, reflecting the persistent high-yield environment. This escalation is directly attributable to the repricing of floating-rate tranches following successive benchmark hikes. Based on 9M26 management accounts, interest coverage ratios have tightened significantly, signaling potential covenant breaches if base rates remain elevated. We are currently unable to assess the full impact on the FY26F refinancing schedule pending the finalization of the proposed credit facility restructuring terms. Consequently, the Target’s capital structure appears increasingly fragile under the current monetary trajectory.

items.t: 利率飙升对融资成本的量化分析
items.en: Throughout FY25, the Target's weighted average cost of debt escalated by 150 basis points to 6.2%, primarily driven by the refinancing of its USD 50 million senior notes under a high-rate environment. This rate hike resulted in an incremental interest expense of USD 0.75 million in FY25, which compressed the net interest margin by approximately 80 basis points. Had the refinanced rate been applied retroactively to the beginning of FY25, the full-year normalized financing cost would have been higher by an additional USD 0.3 million. Looking ahead to FY26F, assuming interest rates plateau at current levels, the annualized debt service obligation is projected to stabilize at USD 3.8 million, representing a 12% year-on-year increase on a normalized basis.

items.t: 折旧政策变更对利润的可比性调整
items.en: Effective from Q1 FY25, the Target extended the estimated useful lives of its core manufacturing equipment from 5 to 8 years, aligning its depreciation policy with industry standards. This accounting estimate change reduced the FY25 depreciation charge by USD 1.2 million, thereby artificially boosting the reported operating profit margin by 2.4 percentage points. On a normalized basis, adjusting for this policy alignment to ensure historical comparability, the 9M26 adjusted EBITDA would be USD 8.5 million instead of the reported USD 9.4 million. While management attributes this adjustment to technological upgrades, the resulting non-cash earnings boost should be excluded when assessing the Target's recurring run-rate profitability.

items.t: 汇率波动对毛利的量化分析

On a constant currency basis, the normalized margin would have reached 32.4%, suggesting that the underlying operational efficiency remained intact. Management has proactively shifted towards a USD-denominated pricing model for 9M26 to natural hedge against future currency volatility. This strategic pivot, coupled with a realized FX gain of $1.5M, has largely neutralized the impact of exchange rate fluctuations on the bottom line for the current period. We have further adjusted for these translation effects to present a clearer view of the recurring EBITDA performance.

items.t: 季节性波动对营运资本的影响
items.en: The Target’s cash flow profile exhibits pronounced seasonality, with historical data showing that approximately 45% of annual collections occur during the peak season in Q4. In FY25, this cyclicality resulted in a temporary working capital build-up of $8.2M, which was primarily funded through a revolving credit facility. As of 9M26, the cash conversion cycle has moderated to 62 days, compared to a 68-day average in FY24, indicating enhanced liquidity management. We expect a significant cash inflow in early FY26F as the receivables from the 2025 holiday season are fully liquidated. Consequently, the normalized operating cash flow, stripping out these timing differences, provides a more accurate representation of the business's self-funding capability.

items.t: 供应链成本上升对毛利的结构性影响
items.en: The Target’s gross margin contracted by 450 basis points during 9M26 compared to the same period in FY25. While management attributes this decline to temporary logistics bottlenecks, our variance analysis reveals a more systemic increase in raw material procurement costs. Benchmarking against industry peers confirms that the Target’s input costs rose by 12% year-on-year, significantly outpacing the 3% price hike implemented in mid-2026. Our inspection of recent purchase orders verifies that supplier price escalations are tied to long-term index-linked contracts rather than transitory freight spikes. notes.why: 使用 'subsequently' 替代简单的 'then'，增强了逻辑的先后递进感，使因果链条更具书面严谨性。
在分析完市场压力后，用 'Accordingly' 引出应对措施，体现了商务写作中“陈述事实-逻辑推导-得出结论”的经典结构。

take: Hedging instruments mitigated some exposure; however, the persistent […] negatively impacted margins.
Cross-border settlement cycles were subsequently extended by […] days to maintain liquidity.
Accordingly, management has recalibrated the […] forecast for FY26F.

items.t: 研发支出资本化的合规判断
items.en: The company capitalized 45% of its R&D expenditure in FY25, a notable increase compared to the 32% recorded in FY24. Such a shift reflects the progression of the 'Project Alpha' into the commercial feasibility stage; whereas, legacy projects continue to be expensed immediately to maintain conservative accounting practices. This dual approach ensures compliance with internal capitalization thresholds. We have scrutinized the underlying project documentation to verify that capitalized costs are strictly attributable to future economic benefits. Accordingly, we suggest further review of the amortization schedule to align with current market lifecycles.

notes.why: 用 'notable' 软化了对数据大幅波动的判断，既指出事实，又保持了审计人员的客观中立立场。
使用 'whereas' 对比两类项目的不同会计处理方式，清晰地展示了公司策略的细分，体现了分析的深度。

notes.q: We have scrutinized the underlying project documentation
notes.why: 用 'scrutinized' 这样具备专业力度的词汇，替代了简单的 'checked'，直接体现尽职调查工作的严谨程度。

take: The company capitalized […]% of its R&D expenditure, a notable increase compared to […]%.
[...] whereas, legacy projects continue to be expensed immediately to maintain conservative practices.
Accordingly, we suggest a review of […] to align with market expectations.

items.t: 客户集中度风险分析
items.en: The Group’s revenue architecture exhibits a pronounced reliance on its top three distributors, which collectively accounted for 68% of total turnover in FY25. This high level of concentration exposes the entity to significant counterparty risk, as the loss of any single major account could precipitate a material decline in top-line performance. While management has initiated a geographical diversification strategy in 9M26, the current penetration rates in emerging markets remain insufficient to offset potential volatility. We advise stakeholders to monitor the renewal status of these primary master-purchase agreements closely. Ultimately, the sustainability of current growth trajectories is contingent upon the Group’s ability to broaden its customer base over the coming fiscal years.

notes.why: 书面用语，比 'relies heavily on' 更正式、客观，避免了口语化的感性表达。
使用 'precipitate' 表示诱发，'material' 在审计中特指重大影响，体现了专业语境。
通过委婉的否定句式来指出业务短板，比直接说 'failed to' 显得更加职业和客观。

take: The entity’s revenue structure exhibits a pronounced reliance on [Customer Name/Segment].
This concentration exposes the Group to [specific risk], which could precipitate a material impact on [financial metric].
The current [strategy/metric] remains insufficient to mitigate the risks associated with [specific issue].

items.t: 压货与渠道退货评估
items.en: Evidence of aggressive channel-stuffing practices surfaced during 9M26, characterized by a notable surge in Q4 FY25 shipments that did not align with downstream sell-through data. Concurrently, the return-to-revenue ratio climbed from 3.2% in FY24 to 7.8% in FY25, suggesting that inventory was pushed prematurely into the distribution channel. Such anomalies indicate a potential disconnect between recognized sales and actual market demand. Unless these channel incentives are restructured, the entity may face substantial liquidity pressure from projected product returns. Investors should exercise caution regarding the quality of earnings reported during periods of abnormal shipment volatility.

notes.why: 在描述财务异常时，用 'characterized by' 引导客观特征，避免使用带有指责意味的口语词汇。
委婉表达销售数据造假或虚报的嫌疑，比 'did not match' 或 'was fake' 更严谨。
在尽调中，对于尚未实锤的风险使用 'suggesting that' 进行推论，是保护审计人员的专业写法。

take: The discrepancy between [shipment data] and [sell-through data] suggests potential channel stuffing.
The return-to-revenue ratio increased from [X]% to [Y]%, which warrants further investigation into [specific revenue stream].
These anomalies indicate a possible misalignment between [recognized revenue] and [actual market demand].

items.t: 供应链成本上升对毛利的影响
items.en: Persistent supply chain disruptions throughout FY25 resulted in a 150-basis-point contraction in gross margins. This deterioration was primarily driven by the escalation of logistics expenses and the procurement of high-cost raw materials. The inability to execute a full pass-through of these costs to end customers further exacerbated the margin compression. Consequently, the company recorded a 4% year-on-year decline in operating profitability as of 9M26. Management’s ongoing efforts to stabilize the cost structure remain critical to a potential recovery in FY26F.

notes.why: 将动词 escalate 转化为名词 escalation，将具体的动作转化为静态的成本归因，提升报告的正式感。
利用名词短语 pass-through 描述定价策略，避免了使用长句解释定价机制，使因果逻辑更紧凑。
用名词短语替代动词短语（margins were compressed），让讨论对象直接成为句子焦点，符合审计文风。

take: The escalation of […] resulted in a […] contraction in margins.
The inability to execute a full pass-through of […] further exacerbated the […].
Management’s ongoing efforts to stabilize […] remain critical to […].

items.t: 利率环境对融资成本的影响
items.en: The prevailing high-interest-rate environment throughout FY25 has led to a significant increase in the company’s debt servicing obligations. Elevated financing costs exerted downward pressure on net income, offsetting the gains from operational efficiency. A strategic transition toward fixed-rate debt instruments in 9M26 mitigated exposure to further volatility in market rates. However, the refinancing of maturing credit facilities remains a primary concern for the company's liquidity profile in FY26F. Careful monitoring of interest coverage ratios is essential to maintaining financial stability.

notes.why: 将‘偿还债务’的动作归纳为名词短语，作为衡量财务负担的核心指标，增强了信息的专业密度。
将‘利润下降’这一抽象结果名词化，使因果关系呈现为一种力的平衡，常用于财经评论。
将动作‘再融资’与对象‘到期信贷额度’合并，在单句中同时交代了动作的实质和背景。

take: The prevailing […] environment has led to a significant increase in […].
Elevated […] exerted downward pressure on […].
The refinancing of […] remains a primary concern for the […].

items.t: 分拆业务的成本分摊分析
items.en: The historical allocation of shared corporate costs to the target division appears aggressive, potentially overstating standalone profitability for FY24 and FY25. Management currently applies a fixed overhead markup of 12% based on headcount, which deviates from the actual resource consumption observed during our 9M26 site visits. We have adjusted the pro-forma EBITDA downward by $4.2 million to reflect a more accurate activity-based costing methodology. This correction aligns the target's operating margins with industry benchmarks, narrowing the variance from 15% to approximately 8%. We recommend that the transaction agreement include a transitional service mechanism to stabilize these cost structures post-closing.

notes.why: 在尽调中软化措辞，用 appears 而非直接指责对方作假，符合客观中立的职业语域。
相比口语中的 doesn't match，deviates from 更加正式，常用于描述实操与逻辑的不符。
专业术语，必须使用财务口径而非简单的 earnings，确保写作的专业精度。

take: The historical allocation of […] appears aggressive, potentially overstating […]
We have adjusted the pro-forma […] downward by […] to reflect a more accurate methodology.
This correction aligns the […] with industry benchmarks, narrowing the variance from […] to […]

items.t: 应收账款回款放缓分析
items.en: Accounts receivable turnover has decelerated significantly throughout 9M26, with the average collection period extending from 65 days in FY25 to 88 days currently. This deterioration is primarily attributed to a shift in client mix toward lower-credit-quality accounts rather than structural liquidity constraints. While the company maintains that these delays are transient, our aging analysis reveals a rising concentration of overdue balances exceeding 180 days. Consequently, we have applied a $2.1 million incremental provision for doubtful accounts to account for potential collection risks. A closer examination of the upcoming FY27 contract renewals will be necessary to determine if this trend represents a systemic credit risk.

notes.why: 用 decelerated 代替 slowed down，体现书面语中的精确性与正式感。
因果关系的专业表达，比 because of 更有说服力，适合报告的归因分析。
会计准则术语，避免使用口语化的 'write-off' 猜测，体现审计工作的严谨性。

take: […] has decelerated significantly throughout […], with the average period extending from […] to […].
This deterioration is primarily attributed to a shift in […] rather than […].
We have applied an incremental provision of […] to account for potential collection risks.

items.t: 人力成本合规性与社保基数
items.en: The target’s historical payroll data reveals a systematic under-contribution to social insurance funds throughout FY24 and FY25. We estimate a potential compliance exposure of RMB 4.2 million, assuming a full-basis remediation for all eligible employees. Management acknowledges this shortfall, attributing it to a legacy practice of calculating contributions based on minimum local thresholds rather than actual gross earnings. To normalize future earnings, we have adjusted the 9M26 EBITDA downwards by RMB 1.8 million to reflect the impact of standardized contribution levels. This pro-forma adjustment provides a more accurate baseline for assessing the company’s recurring labor expenditure.

notes.why: 用 systematic 指代非偶然的、系统性的问题，避免直接用 illegal 等过于情绪化的词汇。
用 remediation 指代补缴或修复，符合尽调中处理历史遗留问题的语境。
用 normalize 明确告知读者这一步是为了将非经常性因素剔除，回归常态化财务表现。

take: We estimate a potential compliance exposure of […] assuming a full-basis remediation.
Management attributes this shortfall to a legacy practice of […].
We have adjusted the […] EBITDA downwards by […] to reflect the impact of […].

items.t: 经销商压货与渠道库存限制
items.en: Our preliminary review of FY25 distributor sell-in data indicates a 14% year-over-year increase in primary shipments, yet end-market sell-out trackers imply constrained downstream absorption. While comprehensive multi-tier inventory audits fall outside the scope of this targeted financial review, available warehouse sampling suggests elevated return risks in specific regional nodes. Within the constraints of current data availability, we cannot definitively quantify the aggregate non-standard credit extended to these tier-1 accounts. Consequently, management should address these visibility gaps through targeted confirmation procedures ahead of the upcoming FY26F closing.

notes.q: While comprehensive multi-tier inventory audits fall outside the scope of this targeted financial review
notes.why: 用明确的边界划分（outside the scope）说明没查全的原因不是偷懒，而是项目授权限制，保护专业信誉。

notes.q: Within the constraints of current data availability
notes.why: 把做不到归结于客观数据条件受限（constraints of current data availability），而非主观能力不足。

notes.q: we cannot definitively quantify the aggregate non-standard credit
notes.why: 用 definitively 和 aggregate 软化语气，准确界定无法给出的具体数字，避免绝对化表述。

take: While [...] falls outside the scope of this targeted review, available [...] suggests [...]
Within the constraints of current data availability, we cannot definitively quantify [...]
Management should address these visibility gaps through [...] ahead of [...]

items.t: 汇率波动与跨境结算敞口
items.en: During the 9M26 reporting period, cross-border settlements across three key emerging market jurisdictions experienced heightened volatility due to localized currency depreciation. Due to the decentralized nature of the target's regional treasury operations, real-time transaction-level FX matching logs were not accessible for our review team. Although we are unable to independently verify the exact hedging efficacy of historical forward contracts executed in FY24, macro-level cash reconciliation points to potential unhedged translation losses. To the extent permitted by local confidentiality covenants, further granular analysis of bank statements is recommended to isolate structural exposure.

notes.q: Due to the decentralized nature of the target's regional treasury operations
notes.why: 归因于对方运营结构的分散性（decentralized nature），把拿不到日志的原因客观化。

notes.q: Although we are unable to independently verify the exact hedging efficacy
notes.why: 坦诚无法独立核实（unable to independently verify），但用 exact 锁定局部边界，显得严谨而非无能。

notes.q: To the extent permitted by local confidentiality covenants
notes.why: 用法律和合规限制（confidentiality covenants）作为做不到某事的挡箭牌，礼貌且专业。

take: Due to the decentralized nature of [...], [...] were not accessible for our review team
Although we are unable to independently verify [...], macro-level [...] points to [...]
To the extent permitted by local confidentiality covenants, further [...] is recommended

items.t: 利率环境与融资成本
items.en: The macroeconomic landscape of FY25 witnessed a sharp acceleration in central bank tightening, resulting in severe compression of corporate liquidity margins. This persistent monetary tightening directly induced a 140-basis-point escalation in the average cost of debt across the portfolio. Furthermore, the systematic expiration of legacy fixed-rate tranches accelerated the transition to unhedged floating liabilities. Consequently, the resulting surge in quarterly interest outlays exerted substantial downward pressure on aggregate free cash flow generation. Management's subsequent implementation of proactive debt restructuring successfully mitigated broader margin erosion in 9M26.

notes.q: a sharp acceleration in central bank tightening
notes.why: 用名词短语 acceleration 和 tightening 代替描述央行收紧动作的动词，将事件静态化、报告化，提升了信息密度。

notes.q: a 140-basis-point escalation in the average cost of debt
notes.why: 将债务成本上升这一个动作转化为名词 escalation 并带有具体量化数据，符合财务报告直接、客观的文风。

notes.q: the systematic expiration of legacy fixed-rate tranches
notes.why: 通过 expiration、tranches 等专业名词串联复杂背景，避免了长句嵌套，使因果关系更加清晰紧凑。

take: The […] of […] resulted in severe compression of […]
This persistent […] directly induced a […] escalation in the average cost of [...]
Management's subsequent implementation of proactive […] successfully mitigated broader [...]

items.t: 研发资本化的判断
items.en: The rigorous evaluation of FY24 technical feasibility milestones governed the unprecedented surge in software development capitalization. This aggressive accounting treatment facilitated the deferral of significant engineering overheads into multi-year intangible assets. However, the subsequent deceleration of commercialization velocity in core product lines triggered immediate impairment testing requirements. Such unfavorable divergence between capitalized expenditure and realized revenue streams necessitated a conservative revision of future asset recovery schedules. Ultimately, auditor scrutiny regarding technological uncertainty led to a substantial retrospective write-down of deferred balances in FY25.

notes.q: The rigorous evaluation of FY24 technical feasibility milestones
notes.why: 用 evaluation 和 milestones 等抽象名词组合替代对技术评估过程的动词化叙述，增强了审计报告的专业感。

notes.q: the deferral of significant engineering overheads into multi-year intangible assets
notes.why: 将费用递延这一会计处理过程压缩为名词短语 deferral，使复杂的财务操作变得高度概括。
将审计师的质疑转化为 scrutiny 这个高信息密度的名词，体现了尽调报告中客观且带有警示意味的语气。

take: The rigorous evaluation of […] governed the unprecedented surge in [...]
Such unfavorable divergence between […] and […] necessitated a conservative revision of [...]
Auditor scrutiny regarding […] led to a substantial retrospective write-down of [...]

items.t: 经销商压货归因分析
items.en: Management attributed the 18% surge in FY25 revenue primarily to robust terminal demand across tier-two cities. However, our preliminary channel checks suggest that this top-line expansion was largely driven by aggressive distributor loading ahead of the price hike. Furthermore, inventory reconciliations between distributor ERP logs and company dispatch records reveal an average 35-day discrepancy in stock-in transit. These quantitative anomalies imply that reported sell-in figures may significantly overstate actual sell-out velocity.

notes.q: Management attributed the 18% surge in FY25 revenue primarily to
notes.why: 用 attribute to 明确指出这是管理层的口径，主动将信源归责于对方，为后续转折做铺垫。

notes.q: our preliminary channel checks suggest that
notes.why: 用 suggest 替代 prove，在买方尽调中保持客观审慎的专业语气，避免过早下定论。
通过具体数字（35天）和客观动作（reconciliations... reveal），将查到的客观事实与主观说法形成对比。

take: [Party A] attributed [metric] primarily to [stated reason]
Our preliminary [channel checks / interviews] suggest that [inferred reality]
Reconciliations between [source A] and [source B] reveal a [number]-day discrepancy in [metric]

items.t: 社保基数合规归因
items.en: The target company claimed that its headcount reduction in 9M26 naturally lowered overall social insurance obligations. Conversely, our interviews with departing factory workers indicate that previous underreporting of payroll bases was systemic to bypass regulatory thresholds. Meanwhile, audit sampling of bank statements and local tax filings uncovers an estimated 22% social security contribution shortfall. Consequently, we understand that current labor cost savings stem from non-compliant base adjustments rather than operational efficiency.

notes.why: 用 claim 带有保留态度地引述被审计方的主张，暗示其真实性需要进一步核实。

notes.q: our interviews with departing factory workers indicate that
notes.why: 明确指出我们查到的信息来源（离职员工访谈），增强证据链的透明度。

notes.q: we understand that current labor cost savings stem from
notes.why: 用 we understand that 将前述矛盾证据整合为买方最终的专业认知，表述委婉且逻辑严密。

take: The target company claimed that [stated reason]
Our [interviews / site visits] with [source] indicate that [inferred reality]
We understand that [target outcome] stems from [root cause] rather than [distractor]

items.t: 折旧政策变更的影响
items.en: In FY25, the target company prospectively adjusted the estimated useful lives of its core manufacturing machinery from 8 years to 12 years. This accounting estimate revision reduced annual depreciation expense by approximately RMB 14.2 million, which effectively inflated operating profit for the period. To establish a normalized baseline for our valuation, we added back this non-operational variance to historical EBITDA. Furthermore, we adjusted the baseline downward to reflect the ongoing capital expenditure required to maintain these aging assets. Consequently, the normalized EBITDA for FY25 stands at RMB 86.5 million rather than the reported RMB 100.7 million.

notes.q: prospectively adjusted the estimated useful lives
notes.why: 用 prospectively 表明会计估计变更采取未来适用法，不追溯调整前期，属审计报告标准措辞。
用 effectively 软化了语气，既指出利润虚增的事实，又避免了直接使用操纵利润等带有主观指控的词。

notes.q: To establish a normalized baseline for our valuation
notes.why: 用 infinitive phrase 作目的状语，清晰向买方交代进行各项数字调整的商业动机和估值逻辑。

take: [verb: adjust / revise] the estimated useful lives of [asset category] from [X] years to [Y] years
This accounting estimate revision reduced [expense item] by approximately [amount], which effectively inflated [profit metric]
To establish a normalized baseline for our valuation, we added back this non-operational variance to [financial metric]

items.t: 人力成本与社保基数
items.en: During 9M26, direct labor costs increased by 14.8% year-over-year, driven primarily by a regulatory upward adjustment in the mandatory social security contribution baseline. This statutory adjustment added an estimated RMB 6.3 million in incremental overhead that the company could not fully pass on to end customers. On a normalized run-rate basis, we estimate this regulatory pressure will permanently compress gross margins by roughly 120 basis points. Management has initiated automation projects to mitigate these ongoing personnel headwinds starting in FY27. However, short-term earnings visibility remains constrained by these rigid statutory obligations.

notes.q: driven primarily by a regulatory upward adjustment
notes.why: 用 passive voice 配合 driven by 明确指出成本上升的外部监管原因，归因清晰。
使用 run-rate 概念把前三季度的数据年化并剔除偶发因素，是财务尽调中预测未来常态的固定说法。

notes.q: permanently compress gross margins by roughly 120 basis points
notes.why: 用 bps（基点）精确量化利润率的收窄幅度，体现财务英语对微小变动的专业度。

take: [cost item] increased by [X]% year-over-year, driven primarily by [driver]
On a normalized run-rate basis, we estimate this [factor] will permanently [compress / expand] [margin metric] by roughly [X] basis points
Short-term earnings visibility remains constrained by these rigid [statutory / contractual] obligations
